# Graph operations · layout

Ports, defaults, and constraints come from the registered operations. Use `graph describe <op> --json` for the full structured record.

### layout.boxes



Origin: toolkit.

| Direction | Port | Type | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Input | `width` | `number` | Required | pixels · {"finite":true,"integer":true,"min":1} |
| Input | `height` | `number` | Required | pixels · {"finite":true,"integer":true,"min":1} |
| Input | `boxes` | `array<record>` | Required | {"items":"record"} |
| Output | `value` | `record` | — | {"layout":"Plain named object"} |

Guides: [guide](../headless-authoring.md#relative-boxes)

Get the runnable example with `ink-studio graph describe layout.boxes --example > example.json`.
Run it with `ink-studio graph run example.json`.
